description: Wasserversorgungsnetz HAMBURG WASSER is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The Hamburg water supply network comprises geodata on the water - distribution networks and transport networks within the network area. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water supply network HAMBURG WASSER" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Versorgungsunternehmen, Netzbetreiber, REGI, Transportnetz, Verteilnetz, Wasser. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
